# The refresh button in the market panel's Trade tab. Recomputes the
# suggestions now instead of waiting for the month to turn.
st_rec_refresh_sgui = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { is_player = yes }
	effect = { st_rec_scan = yes }
	ai_is_valid = { always = no }
	ai_chance = { base = 0 }
}

# Forced scans when the player opens the Trade tab (Damien, 2026-11-13: the
# list must never be empty there). Two hooks, each logging its own tag,
# since the earlier ones (a trigger_on_create state and a _show state, both
# on zero-size widgets) never fired: OPEN_TAB from an extra onclick on the
# Trade tab button, OPEN_SHOW from a _show state on vanilla's own Trade
# section, whose visibility flips with the tab.
st_rec_open_tab_sgui = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { is_player = yes }
	effect = {
		# Prices move once a day, so a second scan on the same day (both
		# hooks on one click, or reopening the tab while paused) would
		# repeat the first; the refresh button always scans.
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = st_rec_fresh } }
			debug_log = "ST_REC|OPEN_TAB|scan|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]"
			st_rec_scan = yes
		}
		else = {
			debug_log = "ST_REC|OPEN_TAB|skip|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]"
		}
	}
	ai_is_valid = { always = no }
	ai_chance = { base = 0 }
}
